studies.rationale: Cellular clathrin/AP2 geometry and tension perturbation: a direct clathrin candidate for observation and independent-control eligibility.
Clathrin reconstitution with membrane elasticity manipulation and tether-force measurement: a prospective calibration route with explicitly different geometry.

selection: These two named primary candidates were selected from known clathrin tension/reconstitution work before detailed retrieval; initial title searches verified identity. No candidate expansion after eligibility results.
question: Can either public experimental system supply independent mechanical controls and observations for separating curvature from balanced load, or a defensible narrower calibration comparison?
eligibility: measured vs model-inferred quantities and actual observable geometry
independent kappa/tension/traction calibration and reaction mapping
evidence that perturbations preserve required source fields
spatial traction or two distinct known rigidities with invariant fields, or explicit alternative identifiability argument
registered profiles, scale/pose/covariance and replicate mapping
public data access, sizes and licenses; no request-only data treated as accessible

reading_bounds.supplement_policy: Text/metadata only; inspect size before any retrieval. No full movies/bulk archives, no author contact, no paid access. A larger supplement can be recorded uninspected rather than downloaded.

stop_condition: One independently reviewed eligibility table and precise proposed small-data comparison or stopped empirical branch with minimum prospective requirements. No fit, numerical model, raw pipeline, broad search or biological preference.
